question: Which body recommends the distribution of tax revenue between the Centre and States?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Finance Commission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **Finance Commission** is a constitutional body established under **Article 280** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Its primary role is to recommend the distribution of **tax revenues** between the Centre and the States and among the States themselves.
 
• The President of India constitutes the Finance Commission every **five years** or earlier if deemed necessary, to ensure equitable distribution of financial resources.
 
• The recommendations made by the Finance Commission aim to balance the fiscal needs of the Centre and States in line with their responsibilities.
 
• The **15th Finance Commission**, chaired by **N.K. Singh**, was set up in **2017** and its recommendations cover the period from **2021 to 2026**.
